World design

Brinewake Coast

Water resonators from each region converge at a ruined sea lock. Resolve the regional conflict through a cooperative encounter rather than an endless world simulation.

Climate, lighting and weather

Storm coast with clear breaks, sea fog, rain and authored tide visuals; initial tide does not dynamically reshape navmesh.

Factions

Tidebound League; River Compact

Settlement and service placement

Saltreach harbor supplies full services, coastal quest contacts, boat-gate waypoint and dungeon assembly point.

Travel-time tests

Proposed 4-minute harbor-to-ruin approach and 6-minute coast-road loop. Boat transitions are controlled loading gates, not an unbuilt sailing simulator.

Environmental hazards

Surf/deep-water boundaries, sea-cliff drops and storm visibility; safe dry fishing platforms and respawn approaches.

Quest arc and consequences

Water resonators from each region converge at a ruined sea lock. Resolve the regional conflict through a cooperative encounter rather than an endless world simulation.

Landmarks and discovery

Saltreach Harbor; Broken Tidewall; Sea Lock Ruins

Enemy families

Shale crabs (42–45); Storm gulls (44–47); Tide custodians (47–50)

Ore distribution

SaltIron: cliffs; Stormglass: rare exposed ledges

Tree distribution

Driftwood: beach candidate sites; CoastPine: sheltered coves

Fish species pools

TideMackerel: piers; StormCod: deep water; PearlSkate: rare weather-enabled pool

Music and ambience

Low sea percussion, waves and harbor work; optional reduced storm intensity.

3D art production requirements

Coastal cliffs, harbor/boat props, seawall/ruin kit, ocean/shore materials and creatures. No ships are supplied by the character ZIP.

Optimization and streaming

Cap ocean/weather rendering, stage shoreline collision and cull distant decorative boats. Server fishing tests use approved volumes, not rendered wave height.

Gate authoring

Author dry clear arrival spawns outside trigger bounds. Validate compatible build/capacity/eligibility before issuing a ticket. Gate labels are not stable identity; use the listed IDs. The reciprocal pair is checked by the documentation validator.

Concrete production and test steps

  1. Create the map/definition according to the asset pages; only activate the first-phase portion now.
  2. Graybox services/roads/water with legal primitives and validate capsule/navigation before art replacement.
  3. Register stable site/gate/encounter/NPC/objective IDs through the existing schemas.
  4. Assign current-phase references in zone runtime and run two-client admission/travel tests.
  5. Boat gate moves only the requesting party members with individual tickets.
  6. Server restart during bite produces no catch unless receipt committed.
  7. Rare weather fish rule is disabled until explicitly balanced and versioned.
  8. Endgame dungeon return retains inventory, quest completion and safe hub.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
